data.exact_reserve_text: Of the adverse claims movement of GBP 3.4m in the year ended 31 December 2015, GBP 0.4m related to the older years 2006-2010 which appear to have achieved a degree of stability, GBP 2.2m to the 2011 year of account and GBP 0.8m to the pure year of account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse claims movement on older years (2006-2010)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse movement of GBP 0.4m in CY15 related to older years 2006-2010 (appeared to achieve a degree of stability).

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse claims movement on 2011 year of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse movement of GBP 2.2m in CY15 attributed to the 2011 year of account (liability/long-tail development).
2012 year of account movement in 2015 of GBP (3.2)m comprising claims charges of GBP (3.4)m (gross) and other adjustments; drove decision to keep the year in run-off.

prior_year_events.event_name: Australian tax rebate uncertainty affecting 2013 YOA
prior_year_events.impact_description: Potential Australian tax rebate (forecast AUD1m) for 2013 year lodged but not recognised; contributed to decision to place 2013 year into run-off.

named_events.loss_description: One of the two main CAT events giving rise to a gross loss of GBP 4.8m and net loss of GBP 1.8m (affected 2014 year of account results).

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2015 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 32.218m. The claims development triangle shows adverse prior-year development overall, with a calculated gross strengthening of approximately GBP 6.295m (19.5% of opening reserves), driven principally by adverse development in the liability (casualty) book and recalibration of IBNR/reserving assumptions. Management tightened reserves following external actuarial review and uncertainty over reinsurance and Australian tax rebates contributed to the decision to keep the 2012 and 2013 years in run-off.
raw_causal_phrases: uncertainty on collecting refunds on Australian taxes
liability class has the longest tail
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) was not stated as a single explicit gross movement figure; value reported was calculated from the gross claims development (triangle) on page 37. The report contains explicit gross movements for specific years of account (e.g. 2012 YOA adverse movement GBP 3.4m) but no single consolidated 'movement in prior year's provision' gross line. Gross premium by regulatory class (segmental split) was not found in the provided pages, so gross_premium_mix is empty.
